coordinate_convention.eda_global: x right, y up; mil values multiplied by 0.0254

xy_allowance_status: proposed mechanical design allowance, not measured package tolerance
source_boundary: Current live exports supplied by root; no subagent live EDA access or mutation

Support-hole copper and contact-annulus analysis is owned by layout agent; no support-ring release in this report
